# Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham
Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham is a Hyderabad-based student-entrepreneur, Founder of Reddy Experts™, an independent property intelligence platform and real estate creative division.

"I build first, polish later."

## About Me
Bridging Engineering, Technology, and Real Estate
I'm a civil engineering student at RGUKT Basar and a student-entrepreneur based in Hyderabad, Telangana. I work at the intersection of technology, real estate, and business — building practical, data-driven systems rather than academic-only projects.

Currently, I run Reddy Experts™, an independent property intelligence platform and real estate creative division under Synergy Reddy Group, which I founded in June 2026. We combine physical property audits, 8-point structural ratings, honest video walkthroughs, and high-converting real estate marketing for builders and agents across Hyderabad and Telangana.

Previously, I founded Canies Academy™, an edtech venture that is temporarily closed as I focus on scaling Reddy Experts.

- Execution First: I focus on breaking complex problems into deployable solutions using technology, data, and structured decision-making.
- Scalable Systems: I believe real impact comes from building systems that scale, not just learning tools or collecting certificates.
- Venture Design: Driven by curiosity and experimentation to create product-based businesses that solve real-world problems.

## Categorized Expertise
A holistic approach to real estate technology — from physical property audits to high-converting digital marketing systems.

- Property Intelligence: 8-point structural audits, Honest video walkthroughs, Independent, never sponsored, Construction quality analysis, Future value ROI.
- Technology & Systems: Web apps & internal tools, Linux & cloud systems, AI-assisted workflows, Databases & deployment.

## Professional History
- Reddy Experts™ — Founder & Chief Architect (June 2026–Present). Founded an independent property intelligence platform and real estate creative division under Synergy Reddy Group. Built an 8-point structural audit system for honest property reviews across Hyderabad and Telangana. Launched real estate marketing packages for builders & agents. Serving buyers with lower-commission access and builders with plans from ₹10,000.
- Canies Academy™ — Founder & CEO (2023–2026, Temporarily Closed). Founded and scaled an edtech venture training school students in emerging tech (AI, IoT, cybersecurity). Built an industry-integrated talent pipeline for tech skills. Operations paused as focus shifted to Reddy Experts.
- Synergy Reddy Group™ — Co-Founder, CEO & Chief Architect (2023–Present). Parent group spanning real estate, edtech, digital marketing, and campus commerce. Worked with 5+ startups on automation, scaling, and product strategy. Ran Tech Olympiad 2025 and TechSpark 2025 nationwide student events.
- Black Box — Director (2023–2024). Directed a campus-based smart snacks store with 5-minute delivery. Impacted 5,000+ students' lives via late-night campus logistics. Managed end-to-end rapid food distribution.

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)
Q1: Who is Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham?
A1: Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham is an Indian student-entrepreneur based in Hyderabad, Telangana. He is the Founder & Chief Architect of Reddy Experts™, an independent property intelligence platform and real estate creative division, and previously founded Canies Academy™, an edtech venture.

Q2: What is Reddy Experts?
A2: Reddy Experts™ is an independent property intelligence platform and real estate creative division based in Hyderabad, founded by Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham in June 2026. It provides 8-point property audits, honest video walkthroughs, and real estate marketing creatives for builders and agents across Hyderabad and Telangana.

Q3: What is the 8-point property audit?
A3: The Reddy Experts 8-point audit is an independent evaluation framework covering construction quality, ventilation flow, natural lighting, ease of access, future value ROI, Vastu compliance, neighbourhood quality, and legal clearance. Every property is physically visited and rated, never sponsored.

Q4: What happened to Canies Academy?
A4: Canies Academy™, an edtech venture founded by Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham, is temporarily closed as of 2026. The founder shifted focus to scaling Reddy Experts™.

Q5: What is Synergy Reddy Group?
A5: Synergy Reddy Group™ is a student-led startup conglomerate founded in 2023 and led by Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham. Its ventures have included Reddy Experts (real estate), Canies Academy (edtech), and Black Box Hub (campus commerce).

Q6: Where is Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham based?
A6: He is based in Hyderabad, Telangana, India, and studies at Rajiv Gandhi University of Knowledge Technologies (RGUKT) Basar.

Q7: What certifications does Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham hold?
A7: His certifications include Digital Productivity with AI (UNICEF), AI for Entrepreneurship (Intel), Network Security Engineer (Skill India), Software Engineering Job Simulation (JPMorgan Chase), and multiple Coursera certificates in WordPress, SEO, and Business Analysis.

Q8: What is Reddy Decoded?
A8: Reddy Decoded is Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham's content brand on YouTube and Instagram where he documents his journey building technology products and startups, breaking down AI, tech, and entrepreneurship for a general audience.

Q9: How can I contact Shrikanteshwar Reddy Pasham?
